description: Dynamic Island-style Windows overlay with media controls, notifications, focus timers, system monitoring, volume mixer, and notes.
notes: The optional Prism AI assistant requires the GROQ_API_KEY environment variable; other application features do not require it.
Requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Install the Evergreen Runtime separately only if WebView2 is missing: https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/.
